title: Paid ads flow: see what the Google Ads campaign spends and what each subscription costs
description: The Owner runs a Google Ads campaign for Frequency (Find your people locally, goal: subscriptions) and nothing in FlowWeb shows it. Ship a read-only flow, paid-ads, in the Frequency project: flows/paid-ads/ (stream, config, project), daemon logic that reads the campaign's daily numbers and decides a next move, GET /v1/flows/paid-ads, and a section on the web Flows page. Daily numbers come from Google Ads campaign report CSVs the Owner drops into $FW_HOME/flows/paid-ads/imports/ (title lines, then a header row with Day, Campaign, Impr., Clicks, Cost, Conversions; amounts may carry commas). Rows for other campaigns are ignored; a later day's file replaces an earlier one's numbers for the same day. The view gives totals and last-7-days figures (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, cost per click, subscriptions, cost per subscription) and one next move: waiting_for_data with no rows, learning while fewer than learning_days days have data, check_tracking when spend has reached check_tracking_multiple times the target cost per subscription with zero subscriptions, over_target when cost per subscription is above target, on_target otherwise. The flow never changes the campaign, its budget or its bids: it holds no ad account credential and its stream has no outward action class. Pulling the same numbers automatically from Google Analytics is a later row.
acceptance: flows/paid-ads/stream.json ships disabled at L1 with a dollar cap, and its action classes are read only
A fresh fwd serves GET /v1/flows/paid-ads with next move waiting_for_data and zero spend
An imported report CSV with five days of spend gives totals that match it and next move learning; another campaign's rows are not counted
Twenty days of spend past the check-tracking line with no subscription gives check_tracking
Twenty days with cost per subscription above target gives over_target, and below target gives on_target
The web UI shows the flow on the Flows page with no horizontal scroll at 390 px
